```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
install.packages(c("rvest", "polite", "tidyverse", "janitor", "httr", "glue"))

library(rvest)
library(polite)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(httr)
library(glue)
library(here)
```

## Constants & Utilities

```{r constants}
BASE_URL  <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurovision_Song_Contest_{year}"
ALL_YEARS <- setdiff(1956:2026, 2020)

# Safe null-coalescing row count — avoids %||% version issues entirely
safe_nrow <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) 0L else nrow(x)

# Strip footnote markers like [a], [1], [note 1] and collapse whitespace
clean_text <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_remove_all("\\[\\s*[\\w\\s]+\\s*\\]") |>
    str_squish()
}
```

## Session Builder

```{r session}
make_session <- function(year) {
  url <- glue(BASE_URL, .open = "{", .close = "}")
  tryCatch(
    polite::bow(
      url,
      user_agent = "EurovisionScraper/1.0 (educational research project)",
      delay      = 1.5
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message(glue("  [ERROR] Could not connect to {year}: {e$message}"))
      NULL
    }
  )
}
```

## Core Table Parser

```{r parser}
parse_wiki_table <- function(table_node, year, label) {
  tryCatch({
    df <- table_node |>
      html_table(fill = TRUE, header = TRUE) |>
      as_tibble(.name_repair = "unique") |>
      mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
      mutate(across(everything(), clean_text)) |>
      janitor::clean_names()

    # Drop fully empty rows and columns
    df <- df |>
      filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x) & .x != "")) |>
      select(where(~ any(!is.na(.x) & .x != "")))

    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

    df |> mutate(year = year, table_label = label, .before = 1)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("  [WARN] parse failed '{label}' ({year}): {e$message}"))
    NULL
  })
}
```

## Flat-Node Section Table Finder

```{r finder}
# ── KEY FIX ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Instead of walking XML siblings (which breaks across Wikipedia's varying
# page structures), we:
#   1. Select ALL nodes of interest in document order using a single XPath
#   2. Iterate through them linearly, tracking which heading we are "under"
#   3. Collect tables that fall under a matching heading
# This is robust to any nesting structure Wikipedia uses.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

find_section_tables <- function(page_html, keywords) {

  # Pull every heading and wikitable in document order
  # XPath union preserves document order in xml2
  all_nodes <- page_html |>
    html_elements("h2, h3, h4, table")

  results          <- list()
  current_heading  <- NULL   # text of the heading we are currently under
  current_level    <- 99L    # numeric level (2, 3, 4) of that heading
  under_match      <- FALSE  # are we currently under a matching heading?

  for (node in all_nodes) {
    tag <- node |> html_name()

    # ── If this node is a heading ──────────────────────────────────────────
    if (tag %in% c("h2", "h3", "h4")) {
      level <- tag |> str_extract("[0-9]") |> as.integer()
      text  <- node |> html_text(trim = TRUE)
      lower <- str_to_lower(text)

      # A same-or-higher heading closes the current section
      if (level <= current_level) {
        under_match     <- FALSE
        current_heading <- NULL
        current_level   <- 99L
      }

      # Check if this heading matches any keyword
      if (any(str_detect(lower, str_to_lower(keywords)))) {
        current_heading <- text
        current_level   <- level
        under_match     <- TRUE
      }

      next  # headings themselves are never tables
    }

    # ── If this node is a table and we are under a matching heading ────────
    if (tag == "table" && under_match) {
      classes <- node |> html_attr("class")
      if (!is.na(classes) && str_detect(classes, "wikitable")) {
        # Use heading text + index to allow multiple tables per section
        key <- paste0(current_heading, " [", length(results) + 1, "]")
        results[[key]] <- node
      }
    }
  }

  results
}
```

## Extraction Functions

```{r extraction}
# ── Host City ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_host_city <- function(page_html, year) {
  city  <- NA_character_
  venue <- NA_character_

  # ── Strategy 1: infobox ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  infobox <- page_html |> html_element("table.infobox")

  if (length(infobox) > 0 && !is.na(infobox)) {
    rows <- infobox |> html_elements("tr")

    for (row in rows) {
      th <- row |> html_element("th")
      td <- row |> html_element("td")

      if (length(th) == 0 || length(td) == 0) next
      if (is.na(html_text(th)) || is.na(html_text(td))) next

      th_text <- str_to_lower(html_text(th, trim = TRUE))

      if (str_detect(th_text, "venue")) {
        # The venue <td> contains:
        #   Line 1: Venue name  (e.g. "Teatro Kursaal")
        #   Line 2: City, Country (e.g. "Lugano, Switzerland")
        # These are separated by a <br> or <a> tags — we extract
        # the raw text nodes individually using xml2 [1]
        raw_lines <- td |>
          html_children() |>                      # get child nodes
          map_chr(~ html_text(.x, trim = TRUE)) |> # text of each child
          discard(~ .x == "")                      # drop blanks

        if (length(raw_lines) >= 2) {
          # Multi-line: first part = venue, last part = city
          venue <- clean_text(raw_lines[1])
          city  <- clean_text(raw_lines[length(raw_lines)])
        } else {
          # Single line fallback — try splitting on comma logic
          full  <- clean_text(html_text(td, trim = TRUE))
          # Insert separator where venue ends and city begins:
          # matches a lowercase letter immediately before an uppercase
          split <- str_match(full, "^(.*[a-z])([A-Z].*)$")
          if (!is.na(split[1, 2])) {
            venue <- str_squish(split[1, 2])
            city  <- str_squish(split[1, 3])
          } else {
            city <- full
          }
        }
        break
      }

      # Fallback label: "Host city" (used on some older pages)
      if (str_detect(th_text, "host city")) {
        city <- clean_text(html_text(td, trim = TRUE))
        break
      }
    }
  }

  # ── Strategy 2: any <th> labelled "Host city" ───────────────────────────
  if (is.na(city)) {
    for (th in page_html |> html_elements("th")) {
      if (str_detect(str_to_lower(html_text(th, trim = TRUE)), "host city")) {
        td <- th |> html_element(xpath = "following-sibling::td[1]")
        if (length(td) > 0 && !is.na(td)) {
          city <- clean_text(html_text(td, trim = TRUE))
          break
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # ── Strategy 3: regex on lead paragraph ─────────────────────────────────
  if (is.na(city)) {
    lead <- page_html |>
      html_element("div.mw-parser-output p") |>
      html_text()
    if (!is.na(lead)) {
      m <- str_match(lead, "held (?:in|at) ([A-Z][a-zA-Z\\s\\-]+),")
      if (!is.na(m[1, 2])) city <- str_squish(m[1, 2])
    }
  }

  tibble(
    year      = year,
    venue     = replace_na(venue, "Unknown"),
    host_city = replace_na(city,  "Unknown")
  )
}

# ── Participants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_participants <- function(page_html, year) {
  keywords <- c("participating countr", "countries", "participant", "entr")
  tbls     <- find_section_tables(page_html, keywords)
  frames   <- compact(imap(tbls, ~ parse_wiki_table(.x, year,
                                   paste("participants |", .y))))

  # Fallback: first wikitable on the page
  if (length(frames) == 0) {
    tbl <- page_html |> html_element("table.wikitable")
    if (length(tbl) > 0 && !is.na(tbl)) {
      df <- parse_wiki_table(tbl, year, "participants | fallback")
      if (!is.null(df)) frames <- list(df)
    }
  }

  if (length(frames) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(frames)
}


# ── Results (semi-finals + grand final) ───────────────────────────────────────
extract_results <- function(page_html, year) {
  keywords <- c("semi-final", "semifinal", "grand final", "final",
                "result", "scoreboard", "voting", "detailed")
  tbls     <- find_section_tables(page_html, keywords)
  frames   <- compact(imap(tbls, ~ parse_wiki_table(.x, year,
                                   paste("results |", .y))))

  # Fallback: all wikitables
  if (length(frames) == 0) {
    all_tbls <- page_html |> html_elements("table.wikitable")
    frames   <- compact(imap(seq_along(all_tbls), ~ parse_wiki_table(
      all_tbls[[.x]], year, paste("results | table", .x)
    )))
  }

  if (length(frames) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(frames)
}


# ── Broadcasts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_broadcasts <- function(page_html, year) {
  keywords <- c("broadcast", "broadcaster", "television", "relay", "coverage")
  tbls     <- find_section_tables(page_html, keywords)
  frames   <- compact(imap(tbls, ~ parse_wiki_table(.x, year,
                                   paste("broadcasts |", .y))))

  if (length(frames) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(frames)
}
```

## Main Scraping Loop

```{r scrape, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
scrape_all_eurovision <- function() {

  # Dynamic named lists — no pre-allocation, no index gaps
  host_city_list    <- list()
  participants_list <- list()
  results_list      <- list()
  broadcasts_list   <- list()

  total <- length(ALL_YEARS)

  for (i in seq_along(ALL_YEARS)) {
    year   <- ALL_YEARS[i]
    yr_key <- as.character(year)
    cat(sprintf("[%2d/%d] Scraping %d ... ", i, total, year))

    # Build session
    session <- make_session(year)
    if (is.null(session)) { cat("SKIPPED (session)\n"); next }

    # Fetch page
    page_html <- tryCatch(
      polite::scrape(session),
      error = function(e) {
        message(glue("  [ERROR] {year}: {e$message}")); NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(page_html)) { cat("SKIPPED (scrape)\n"); next }

    # Extract — each wrapped in its own tryCatch so one failure
    # never kills the whole loop
    hc <- tryCatch(extract_host_city(page_html, year),
                   error = function(e) {
                     message(glue("  [WARN] host_city {year}: {e$message}"))
                     NULL })

    pp <- tryCatch(extract_participants(page_html, year),
                   error = function(e) {
                     message(glue("  [WARN] participants {year}: {e$message}"))
                     NULL })

    rs <- tryCatch(extract_results(page_html, year),
                   error = function(e) {
                     message(glue("  [WARN] results {year}: {e$message}"))
                     NULL })

    bc <- tryCatch(extract_broadcasts(page_html, year),
                   error = function(e) {
                     message(glue("  [WARN] broadcasts {year}: {e$message}"))
                     NULL })

    # Store by named key — skipped years simply have no entry
    host_city_list[[yr_key]]    <- hc
    participants_list[[yr_key]] <- pp
    results_list[[yr_key]]      <- rs
    broadcasts_list[[yr_key]]   <- bc

    cat(sprintf("OK  (p=%d, r=%d, b=%d)\n",
                safe_nrow(pp), safe_nrow(rs), safe_nrow(bc)))

    Sys.sleep(0.5)
  }

  list(
    host_cities  = bind_rows(compact(host_city_list)),
    participants = bind_rows(compact(participants_list)),
    results      = bind_rows(compact(results_list)),
    broadcasts   = bind_rows(compact(broadcasts_list))
  )
}

cat("Starting Eurovision Wikipedia scraper...\n\n")
eurovision_data <- scrape_all_eurovision()
```
